title: Checkpointing and Fault Tolerance Mechanism in Apache Hadoop MapReduce
description: The Checkpointing and Fault Tolerance Mechanism in Apache Hadoop MapReduce provides fault tolerance and recovery capabilities for MapReduce jobs. It allows the system to checkpoint the state of the job at regular intervals and recover from failures by restoring the state of the job from the last checkpoint. The mechanism is implemented using the CheckpointService, CheckpointNamingService, and CheckpointID classes. It also provides support for distributed caching and task execution. The system is designed to ensure scalability, reliability, and performance.

title: "File System APIs"

title: MapReduce Data Processing Subsystem
description: The MapReduce framework provides a scalable and fault-tolerant solution for processing large datasets in a distributed environment. title: Output Committer
description: The OutputCommitter class is responsible for committing output files in a fault-tolerant manner by splitting the output files into partial and finished files.

title: OutputCommitter Implementation
description: The OutputCommitter interface is responsible for committing or aborting the tasks and jobs in the Hadoop MapReduce framework. The OutputCommitter interface is used by the Hadoop framework to manage the commit and abort process for MapReduce jobs.

description: The code is responsible for creating manifest files for each task attempt and directory in Apache Hadoop MapReduce. The code also includes classes for handling job and task stages, as well as loading manifests for each task attempt. The code is part of the Apache Hadoop MapReduce project and is written in Java.

title: Outputformats and Committers in Apache Hadoop MapReduce
description: Outputformats and Committers in Apache Hadoop MapReduce are responsible for writing the output of MapReduce jobs to HDFS. OutputCommitters are responsible for committing the output of a MapReduce job, including tasks and the job as a whole.

title: CombineFileRecordReader: Merging Small Files for Better Map-task Performance
description: The CombineFileRecordReader class is a crucial component of the Map-Reduce framework, responsible for merging small files into larger files to improve the performance of individual Map-tasks. title: "org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.lib.reduce.WrappedReducer"

title: MapReduce Cluster
description: The MapReduce Cluster is a scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed processing system that handles large data sets. The system is designed to scale up from single servers to thousands of machines, each offering local computation and storage.

title: Security Token Management in Apache Hadoop YARN
